categories.main_business_segments: Teradata operates two primary business segments: Product Sales and Consulting Services. Product Sales includes recurring revenue from cloud and on-premises subscriptions, as well as perpetual software licenses, hardware, and related offerings. Consulting Services provides consulting, implementation, managed services, and support to help customers maximize value from Teradata's analytics and data platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Teradata's core technology is the Teradata Vantage platform, an open and connected hybrid cloud analytics and data platform designed for AI and large-scale data analytics. Key technologies include ClearScape Analytics for in-database analytics and AI/ML, QueryGrid for data integration across multi-cloud and on-premises environments, and support for open table formats like Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake. The company leverages cloud-native architectures, robust workload management, and deep integration with leading cloud providers and AI tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Teradata targets large enterprises that are heavy users of data and view analytics and AI/ML as strategic. Key industries served include Financial Services, Government, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Manufacturing, Retail, Telecommunications, and Travel/Transportation. Customers are typically organizations with complex data management needs and large, diverse user bases.
categories.geographic_coverage: Teradata operates globally, with approximately 5,700 employees in about 40 countries and 41 facilities across 29 countries. In 2024, 49% of total revenues were generated outside the United States, with significant operations in the Americas, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa), and APJ (Asia Pacific and Japan) regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Teradata is positioned downstream in the supply chain, delivering end-user analytics and data management solutions and services directly to enterprise customers. The company outsources hardware assembly to Flex Ltd. and integrates third-party components, focusing its value on software, cloud services, and consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Teradata's strategic focus is on being the leading hybrid cloud analytics and data platform for trusted AI at scale. R&D priorities include enhancing AI/ML capabilities, expanding support for open data formats, deepening cloud and partner integrations, and enabling seamless hybrid and multi-cloud deployments. The company invests significantly in innovation to support AI, cloud migration, and operational excellence, with a strong emphasis on open, connected ecosystems and responsible AI.
categories.revenue_model: Teradata primarily generates revenue through subscription-based offerings, including both capacity-based and consumption-based pricing for its cloud and on-premises platforms. The majority of revenue is recurring, with additional revenue from consulting services, perpetual software licenses, hardware sales, and managed services. Flexible pricing models are designed to align with customer needs and usage patterns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Teradata competes in the highly competitive data management and analytics market against major cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure), cloud-native data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), and traditional enterprise software vendors (IBM, Oracle, SAP). The company differentiates itself through its hybrid and multi-cloud capabilities, scalability for complex workloads, and focus on trusted AI and data integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Teradata reported $1.75 billion in revenue, a 5% decrease from the prior year, with a shift toward recurring revenue and cloud-based offerings. Public Cloud ARR grew 15% year-over-year, while total ARR declined 6% due to on-premises erosion and elongated sales cycles. The company remains profitable, with $114 million in net income and $420 million in cash, and continues to invest in R&D and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Teradata emphasizes its ability to deliver harmonized data, trusted AI, and faster innovation at scale for enterprises with complex analytics needs. Its hybrid cloud platform uniquely supports seamless integration across public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises environments, enabling customers to use preferred tools and technologies. The company highlights its open, connected ecosystem, robust analytics capabilities, and cost-effective scalability as key differentiators.
